title: Nobody bought this $429 bread maker (on purpose)
caption: The $429 bread maker was never meant to sell. It was there to make $275 feel reasonable. That's anchoring: your brain grabs the first number it sees. In 1974 a rigged wheel moved people's answers by 20 points. Who chose the first number you saw today?
